name: yolo-web
description: Unified Chromium-compatible browser monorepo in full Rust (Servo + Obscura + Brave) and Bun for AI agents and humans

scripts.aot:all: bun run aot:human-browser && bun run aot:agent-runner
scripts.rust:build:lto: cargo build --profile release-dist -p obscura-cli -p yolo-browser-cli --bins --features render,stealth
scripts.rust:test: cargo test -p yolo-browser -p obscura-ssrf -p obscura-dom -p euclid -p uluru -p fnv -p servo-svg -p kuchikiki -p bravebot-core -p adblock -p deno_error@0.7.3 -p import_map -p fastwebsockets -p deno_media_type -p deno_unsync -p deno_unsafecell --lib
